title: Český Krumlov Castle

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 equals retained standard viewer DEM497.6021m at the anchor. Upper/lower/theater courts and bridge attachment levels are photo-led exterior estimates; coarse DEM is not a bare-earth survey.

note: Exact-QID compound plus current component plans, courtyard holes, tower height and named bridge fix approximate scale/facing. Court heights, roof/arch profiles, foundations and precise bridge joins remain estimates. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
